# ui.byronwade.com

> Design contracts — fail-closed AI design systems agents install over MCP.
> Meridian is the first live contract. Harbor, Atlas, and Vellum follow.

Browsers hitting these URLs get designed HTML. Agents receive raw text
(`Accept: text/markdown` / `text/plain`, or `?raw=1`).

## Platform

- [Home](https://ui.byronwade.com/): Soft catalog of design contracts · how it works · pricing ($9/mo per MCP)
- [Meridian](https://ui.byronwade.com/meridian): Live cinematic contract (film + proofs)
- [Harbor](https://ui.byronwade.com/harbor) · [Atlas](https://ui.byronwade.com/atlas) · [Vellum](https://ui.byronwade.com/vellum): Soon / preview

## Platform (all contracts)

- [platform.md](https://ui.byronwade.com/meridian/system/platform): Shared architecture — MCP, filenames, JSON keys
- Skeleton SSOT: `lib/platform/skeleton.ts`
- DNA packs: `lib/contracts/dna/{id}.ts` (aesthetics may differ; structure must not)
- Contract JSON (same shape): `/r/{id}.contract.json` for every id

## Meridian — for agents

- [design.md](https://ui.byronwade.com/meridian/design.md): AI contract (frozen vs creative, OKLCH, contrast)
- [agents.md](https://ui.byronwade.com/meridian/agents.md): Strict operating manual — load order, **platform consistency**, skills, gates
- [architecture.md](https://ui.byronwade.com/meridian/architecture.md): System layers
- [llms.txt](https://ui.byronwade.com/meridian/llms.txt): Meridian discovery map
- [meridian.contract.json](https://ui.byronwade.com/r/meridian.contract.json): Machine contract
- Theme grammar lives in-repo at lib/design/

## MCP · CLI

```bash
# Shared MCP (CONTRACT_ID selects DNA) — never fork tool lists per contract
CONTRACT_ID=meridian node packages/contract-mcp/server.mjs

# Validate UI snippets / trees + regenerate ALL contract JSON
node scripts/meridian-check.mjs --json
npm run gen:contract
npm run check:platform
```

MCP tools (identical on every contract): get_contract · resolve_token · validate_ui · list_primitives · get_recipe

## Skill loop (prove on site)

1. Theme → https://ui.byronwade.com/meridian/theme · skill meridian-theme
2. Surface → https://ui.byronwade.com/meridian/surfaces · skill meridian-surface
3. Compose → https://ui.byronwade.com/meridian/surfaces#proofs · skill meridian-compose
4. Cinematic → https://ui.byronwade.com/meridian · skill meridian-cinematic
5. A11y → https://ui.byronwade.com/meridian/theme#contrast · skill meridian-a11y

## Showcase

- [Theme](https://ui.byronwade.com/meridian/theme): Laws, knobs, workbench proof, contrast pairs
- [Surfaces](https://ui.byronwade.com/meridian/surfaces): Workbench + composer + four density lanes
- [Skills](https://ui.byronwade.com/meridian/skills): Top agent skills with on-site proofs
- [System](https://ui.byronwade.com/meridian/system): Ranked research specs
- [Film](https://ui.byronwade.com/meridian): Cinematic film covering the full skill loop

## Install skills

```bash
npx skills add byronwade/ui.byronwade.com
npx skills add byronwade/ui.byronwade.com --skill meridian-theme
```

## Enforce

- npm run check:platform — cross-contract structural parity
- npm run check:design
- npm run check:contrast
- npm run check:meridian
- TypeScript unions in lib/design/grammar.ts
- Cinematic + material laws in lib/design/recipes.ts
- Contract JSON + MCP tools for runtime agent guidance
- Structural renames land in skeleton.ts and regenerate every contract
